status: Source fact; no effect established. KORD 6P67 and M250 blueprints list legacy KingstonLegacy/Mica parts; one is keyed to the current Classic Vertical selector, but its effect classes occur in no current asset.
question: Do the non-attachment parts in weapon blueprint part lists (Class_542ac52c/Field_0cd9f20f) apply effects the site does not model?
method: Claude listed every non-attachment WB part across the 64 weapon WBs (wb_part_census.py). Known or non-combat families were set aside. One worker traced the legacy parts found only on 6P67_WB and M250_WB, with a raw decode control on WM_Foregrip.
censusResult: Non-attachment parts: mounted/MountedPlus and mounted ADS reload (W1), WPM_Sway_IronSights_P05 (L62), sway archetypes 1-5 (base sway; the site shows only relative sway), class traits (not modeled), in-round progression (WeaponSwap, Killshot), DualPrimary and SniperDecoy gadgets, WPM_Procedural_GlobalScaling_Primary (visual Field_149939ab/Field_e9129d03 pairs 0.88/0.6), optic WM_Variable/VUDU zoom parts, and the legacy parts below.

sourceFacts.fact: 6P67_WB Field_0cd9f20f[13..17] and M250_WB [10..12] import Game/KingstonLegacy/Mica/.../OB_WEPATT_*/WM_* parts (6P67: FlashSuppressor, LaserSight, Foregrip, Flashlight, Bipod; M250: LaserSight, FlashSuppressor, Foregrip). No other weapon WB lists them.

WM_Foregrip is keyed by e16013d4-516f-415f-ac33-62df333df40f (current U_WPM_BTM_Vertical04_W35, site classic_vert on kord6p67 and m250) and holds Class_d209d775 Field_7ebe287f = Field_8dc4aaf4 = 0.85 and Class_be3e57cd Field_c752bc95 = Field_a9f023f1 = 1.15.

WM_Bipod holds the same classes with 0.75 and 1.25, keyed to 640ed916-d0da-46d9-b0c1-53dcac9db84e, which no current site choice uses. The Flashlight, LaserSight and FlashSuppressor parts have empty effect arrays and non-current keys.
Class_d209d775 and Class_be3e57cd occur in no current non-legacy asset of this build; GRX_Weapons names none of their fields.

inference: If the Foregrip part applied in multiplayer, Classic Vertical on the KORD 6P67 and M250 would carry two extra effects with unknown targets. The absence of these classes from every current asset suggests leftover legacy data with no current consumer, but that is not proven.
unresolved: Consumer and target of Class_d209d775/Class_be3e57cd; whether the WB part list activates legacy parts in multiplayer. Existing KORD/M250 Classic Vertical panels date from July 2026, before 1.4.3.0, and were not used.
siteImpact: None proposed. Reopen with a consumer trace for either class, or a current-build Classic Vertical comparison on the KORD 6P67 against another AR that isolates an unexplained difference.

relatedChecks.nonSiteGsKeys: Of 167 U_WPM GS keys, 19 are not selectors of any site choice: optic canted/variable GCR tokens, burst and full-auto conditions, Subsonic Frangible (W3), vertical grip selectors W10/W20 and four magazine selectors. U_WPM_MAG_030Cpt2_RPKM_W10 is the site's rpkm 30_fast (Attachment_RPKM_MAG_Compact2, missing from the coverage file); its GS ADS-time and ADS-move-dispersion +1 agree with the site. PP-19 MAG_Compact1 stays an ambiguous-identity choice from the 6 September review.
